analysis: R3 M3 matched-cardinality selective prediction diagnostic
settings: t/s_C in {0.5,1}; sigma=t; lambda=10*||A_t||_2; signed certificate for [0.99t,t] x [lambda,infinity)
random_reference: Exact expected accuracy of a uniformly selected subset of m queries is full-query fitted-classifier accuracy. No random trials.

selectors.score_margin: Top m raw fitted-score top-one minus top-two margins, using exp(-squared_distance/(2*t*t)) @ archived_W. No query-wise renormalization.
selectors.normalized_score_margin: Sensitivity comparator using scores divided by nearest-prototype Gaussian response, the positive row scaling employed in archived prediction verification.
selectors.prototype_distance_margin: Top m gaps between minimum squared distance to a differently labelled prototype and nearest squared distance.
selectors.agreement_gated_score_margin: Restrict to endpoint prediction equal to nearest-prototype label, then top m raw fitted-score margins. Certificate implies all m certified queries belong to this pool.
selectors.agreement_gated_distance_margin: Same agreement pool, then top m prototype class-distance gaps.

ties: Descending ranking score, then ascending archived query ID, then ascending row index. Selection never uses evaluation labels.
denominators: Every selector uses the per-seed certificate cardinality m, all seeds retained. Dataset summaries are arithmetic means and sample SD across five seeds; uncertainty from seed variation is not independent query-sample uncertainty.
class_checks: Full-query and selected true/predicted class counts; predicted-class entropy and dominant share; majority-query reference max empirical class share, explicitly descriptive. Also report training-modal-class constant predictor accuracy.
model_reconstruction: Use archived local-tail readout weights, no new fitting. Reconstruct predictions using raw and row-normalized Gaussian features and require exact agreement with archives.
outputs: Per-query scores/masks/predictions, per-seed and summary CSVs, class counts, protocol and source hashes, runtime and checks. Original files remain unchanged.
